title: On Relative Invariant Subalgebra Rigidity Property
summary: A countable discrete group $Γ$ is said to have the relative ISR-property if for every non-trivial normal subgroup $N\trianglelefteqΓ$ and every von Neumann subalgebra $\mathcal{M}\subseteq L(Γ)$ invariant under conjugation by $N$, one has $\mathcal{M}=L(K)$ for some subgroup $K\leΓ$. Similarly, $Γ$ has the relative $C^*$-ISR-property if every $N$-invariant unital $C^*$-subalgebra $\mathcal{A} \subseteq C_r^*(Γ)$ is of the form $C_r^*(K)$.
